info.title: MetaObjects CLI (dotnet meta
info.description: The MetaObjects .NET command-line tool, installed as `dotnet meta`. Runs C# code generation (`gen`), codegen-drift verification (`verify`), and agent-context docs (`agent-docs`) from typed metadata. Schema migrations are owned by the Node `meta` CLI (ADR-0015).

commands.name: agent-docs
commands.description:
see `npx meta agent-docs`
--version, -v, -V                                print the version
<command> --help                                 that command's usage

commands.name: eject
commands.description:
copy a reference generator into
codegen/generators/ to own (ADR-0034);
see `dotnet meta gen --list`
eject --undo [<name>...] [--force] [--root <dir>]
drop owned copies identical to the shipped
generators (all of them, or the names given;
a copy that differs needs --force). It prints
the Generators.cs edit and never makes it.
There is no `doctor` command: gen's notice
and `gen --list` show identical copies

commands.name: fmt
commands.description:
rewrite metadata into canonical form (#304);
--check lists drift, exits non-zero, changes nothing

commands.name: gen
commands.description:
list available generators (stable names) and exit
verify <metadataDir> [--templates [--prompts <dir>]] [--codegen --out <dir> [--namespace <ns>]] [--db] [--lax]
drift gates (ADR-0021 D2 subverbs):
--templates  template/prompt drift (default); the
directory is --prompts <dir> or the inline
root and must exist; with none it reads
prompts/ if present, else templates/
--codegen    regen-to-temp vs committed --out
(--out defaults to csharp.outDir in
.metaobjects/config.json, as for gen)
--namespace  codegen regen namespace (default: csharp.namespace
in .metaobjects/config.json, else the metadata package)
--db         NOT supported in C# (migrate engine)
--lax        load lax (legacy); strict-by-default
rejects an unregistered @attr (ADR-0023)
--require-implementers
the requirement gate runs on every verify;
this raises a functional requirement nothing
implements to an error (or
META_REQUIRE_IMPLEMENTERS=1)

options.name: --strict
options.description:
without it gen warns and generates. Owned copies identical to the shipped generators
get one advisory line naming `dotnet meta eject --undo`.
column/table naming: "naming" in .metaobjects/config.json (ADR-0058), not a flag here
